metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the opening of term, a door full of gowns, Navarre, and one leaf copied fair.

yesterday: Michaelmas term is open. It runs to the twenty-eighth of November. The bill was the comedy. The gowns came for the king.
Every third man had asked Margery when the king is played. She had said Thursday next. Today was the comedy. The next king is Thursday the sixteenth.
The speeches stay the company's. Abel has the book. York's line and Gaunt's line stay in the play.
You were Navarre. The jaw did the vowels. The Rose bill was The Grecian Comedy.
The leaf is back in the folder. Tomorrow at a quarter past eight you are at the barber's window, and then at the Theatre. The shrew is the afternoon. You are not in it.
